articles.title: Bitcoin enters cool-down phase under $75K as ‘active distribution’ rises
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s slide toward $73,000 triggered active distribution signals, but lowered realized losses and weak spot volumes point to easing sell pressure.

articles.title: AI Models Can’t Agree on Basic Facts Most of the Time, Study Shows
articles.snippet: A new study gave five frontier AI models 1,000 real-world claims to fact-check. They disagreed on 67% of them.

articles.title: AI Chatbots Could Quietly Pull Users Away From Reality, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: Researchers warn that prolonged chatbot interactions could distort how some users experience reality and social connection.
